entities.name: Union of the Third Path
entities.description: Neutral scholarly union founded in Terisiare that hosted a great library, studied magic, and was infiltrated by the Brotherhood of Gix.

entities.name: Archimandrite
entities.description: Head of the Ivory Tower and a founder of the Union who showed strong aptitude in magic.

entities.name: Feldon
entities.description: Scholar and historian, a founder of the Union.

entities.name: Drafna
entities.description: Artificer from the College of Lat-Nam and a founder.

entities.name: Hurkyl
entities.description: Drafna's wife, perhaps the earliest known wizard in Terisiare, who taught magic to her pupils.

entities.name: Loran
entities.description: Archaeologist from Penregon and founder who could not manage any magic.

entities.name: Sunastian Falconer
entities.description: Counted among the founders of the Union.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: One of the brothers whose war the Union stayed neutral from.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: One of the brothers whose war the Union stayed neutral from.

entities.name: Terisia City
entities.description: City whose doors the Third Path threw open.

entities.name: Brotherhood of Gix
entities.description: Group that joined the Union inside, leading to tragedy twelve years later.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: Continent where Hurkyl was the earliest known wizard.

events.summary: The Archimandrite, Feldon, Drafna, Hurkyl and Loran agree to found the Union, with Sunastian Falconer counted as a founder.
events.quote: The Union of the Third Path was a result of an agreement between the Archimandrite of the Ivory Tower

events.summary: The Union announces peace and neutrality in the war between Urza and Mishra while secretly studying magic.
events.quote: The official announcement reflected an agreement of peace and neutrality from the war between Urza and Mishra

events.summary: The Third Path opens Terisia City to all, allowing the Brotherhood of Gix to join them.
events.quote: this enabled the Brotherhood of Gix to join them inside

relations.quote: the artificer Drafna and his wife Hurkyl

relations.note: Hurkyl taught her magic to her pupils, among whom the Archimandrite showed aptitude.
